subject.title: fix(slack): keep health probes within their timeout

question: Should Slack health probes intentionally use single-attempt, fail-fast semantics and should this PR be selected over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107413 as the canonical fix?
rationale: Both branches repair the same bug and cannot both land, while disabling retries deliberately trades transient-failure tolerance for a strict diagnostic deadline.

options.title: Land the absolute-deadline implementation
options.body: Rebase this PR, require clean checks, accept fail-fast probe semantics, land its transport regressions, and close the competing PR.

options.title: Use the competing branch
options.body: Prefer the smaller competing PR only after porting equivalent absolute trickle-response deadline coverage and committed 429 and socket-close regressions.

recommendation.title: Land the absolute-deadline implementation
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, require clean checks, accept fail-fast probe semantics, land its transport regressions, and close the competing PR.

likelyOwner.reason: No Slack-specific CODEOWNER is present, making the repository ownership fallback the best available decision route.
